basic_details.job_title: PM Shri KVS Kasrawad Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | trained graduate teacher (english): Four years Integrated degree course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate as well as in the concerned subject/subjects (minimum 50% in each subject, if combination of subjects desired); OR Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subjects/combination of subjects and in aggregate (minimum 50% in each subject, if combination of subjects desired). English must be a subject in all the three years. Desirable: B.Ed./D.Ed. and CTET qualified for Secondary level (Paper-II). Ability to teach in both Hindi and English medium is mandatory. Computer proficiency/working knowledge is essential.

salary_details.details: The salary and allowances are payable as per Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan norms applicable to contractual teachers/trainers from time to time.

selection_process: a written examination if conducted due to a large number of candidates
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at https://kasrawad.kvs.ac.in/ to download the bio-data format and check details.
Fill out the bio-data form completely.
Prepare a set of self-attested photocopies of all required educational and professional testimonials along with original documents for verification.
Attend the walk-in interview venue at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Kasrawad.
Complete the registration process at the venue between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM on 13 October 2026.
important_instructions: Candidates must bring a fully filled bio-data form along with self-attested copies and original documents for verification; interview is not possible without verification. Proficiency in teaching in both Hindi and English mediums is mandatory. Computer proficiency and working knowledge are essential for the post. The Principal reserves the right to remove any contractual employee without assigning any reason in the interest of the school. Contractual appointments are purely temporary against vacancies or leave vacancies and do not confer any right to regularization or other benefits. If work is found unsatisfactory or regular staff are appointed, contractual services can be terminated without notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is PM Shri KVS Kasrawad Trained Graduate Teacher (English) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview recruitment process conducted by PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Kasrawad to prepare a panel of contractual TGT (English) teachers for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and registration will be held on 13 October 2026, with registration conducted from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview takes place at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Kasrawad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for TGT (English)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a four-year integrated degree course of RCE of NCERT in the concerned subject with 50% marks, or a Bachelor's Degree with 50% marks in aggregate and in each subject, with English as a subject in all three years.

faq.question: Q5. Is CTET mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: CTET qualification for the secondary level (Paper-II) is listed as a desirable qualification.
